_comment: The pictures of the simulator's made-up games (source/sim/sim_games.c), drawn by tools/sim_art.py: `name` as SIM_GAMES has it, `art` the scene (tools/sim_art_scenes.py's SCENES), `hues` its two colours (0 to 1), `logo` the name its icon writes when it is not the name itself. Each game's icon is SIM_ICON_<n>, n its place here. `shots`: the moments of it (1, 2…) the album's screenshots show (source/sim/sim_album.cpp), as SIM_SHOT_<n>_<moment>. A game left out has no icon (sim_games.c: -1).
